events.input: $ node scripts/probe-details.mjs > /tmp/t254-details.txt 2>&1; echo exit $?; grep -cE "FAIL" /tmp/t254-details.txt; grep -E "WARN" /tmp/t254-details.txt | head -8; tail -3 /tmp/t254-details.txt

events.text: Probe-details is still running; I'll wait for it to finish.

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ for i in $(seq 1 55); do grep -qE "^(PASS|FAIL|[0-9]+ FAIL|.*summary)" /tmp/t254-details.txt && break; sleep 10; done; wc -l < /tmp/t254-details.txt; tail -4 /tmp/t254-details.txt
